title: Canaanite Calzones
subtitle: cheese-filled pasta parcels with sage, spinach and tomato
description: Homemade egg pasta dough parcels filled with hard Tzfatit and goat's cheese, boiled and then pan-fried in sage olive oil with spinach and tomato. They can be made ahead and frozen, then cooked straight from the freezer.

steps.text: Make the dough: knead the flour and eggs in a mixer for 5 to 7 minutes until smooth, soft and pliable, adding 2 to 3 tablespoons cold water if too firm. Wrap in cling film and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Make the filling: mix the finely grated Tzfatit, goat's cheese, flour and eggs in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.

Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface to 2 to 3 mm thick and cut 10 cm rounds. Place a spoonful of filling in the centre of each, wet the edges with water (or beaten egg) and fold into half-moons. Arrange on a tray, cover and refrigerate or freeze.
Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the parcels for 2 minutes after they float. Drain.
Lightly fry the sage in the olive oil in a pan, add the spinach and the peeled, deseeded and sliced tomatoes and cook for 1 minute. Add the parcels and fry until lightly golden.
Serve in bowls with the pan oil poured around, topped with olives, grated kashkaval and black pepper.
